name: room
description: Room awareness for coding agents: see teammates' live edits, claim lines before editing, and coordinate with other people's agents.

interface.shortDescription: Work in a shared live room without stepping on teammates
interface.longDescription: Gives Codex the room_* tools: who is editing where right now, claims on line ranges, live vs committed text, and a message bus to other people's agents. Pair with the roomd sync daemon in the same repo.
defaultPrompt: Check the room before editing and claim the lines you touch
